Here is a Semgrep YAML rule that matches the vulnerable behavior and avoids matching the patched behavior:

```yaml
---
id: vuln-dectalk-tts-3600d8ac
title: "Potential HTTP to HTTPS redirect"
description: "The application is using HTTP instead of HTTPS for a potentially sensitive API call."
severity: WARNING
language: typescript
type: taint

pattern:
  - '(new URL\("http:\/\/tts\.cyzon\.us\/tts"\);)'

metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2024-31206
  CWE: CWE-300,CWE-319,CWE-598
---
```

This rule will match any function or method that uses the `new URL('http://tts.cyzon.us/tts')` syntax and throw a warning. The severity is set to WARNING as per your request.
